name: prov_graph
description: Build the provenance graph of the baseline run and gate on its health - every artifact produced and rooted in real inputs; compare plain vs traced outputs by content (tar members, zstd) and tell timestamp-only differences from real ones. Load for the graph stage.

history.why: graph_compare reported 10 differing tars as identical (SHA1 on whole files was fine in theory, but the 2026-10-31 run showed identical verdicts for tars with different md5 - size-level comparison). Now compares by sha256, descends into tar members and zstd members, and classifies timestamp-only differences so the validator reports them inconclusive.

The graph step of a live provenance workflow only builds and validates the graph (plus graph inference algorithms, none yet). Plain-vs-traced output comparison removed (graph_compare, graph_compare_dirs, graph_compare_selftest, science_unchanged; kept in versions/v2). Reads through core.answers.graph, the incremental reader shared with the query tools.

Annotate view: graph_check diffs the aggregated graph (entity types, activity kinds, used/generated/relations) of the spec against the baseline's (core.aggregate); graph_validate fails on expected-but-never-recorded, and states conditional and unexpected ones as assumptions for the user.

Run ef35f429283f graph gate: graph_validate passed 8/8 while graph_compare compared 0 members (default file list = smoke outputs_created = only provenance/PLAN.md, reported missing), so science_unchanged was a vacuous pass. Fix: default to the baseline_plain vs baseline study dirs with the AF3 outputs-af3 tree and *_cut50.pdb (Rosetta is unseeded, not defaulted); record compare_files; comparing zero files is inconclusive, never a pass. The model_group_name date stamp in model.cif is already caught by VOLATILE_DEFAULT as timestamp_only.

graph_compare compared a plain file with itself (absolute outputs_created joined under both dirs): 10 tars 'identical', compared_members 0, science_unchanged inconclusive. Add files argument, directory-walk default, self-compare guard, absolute-path normalisation, and make zero-member/missing comparisons inconclusive.

science_unchanged stayed inconclusive forever when only timestamp_only members differed (elmerfold-prov-20261030-125944: 70 members compared, 0 different, 10 hhsearch_output.hhr Date/Command headers), because nothing could record the user's call and pipeline_advance refuses inconclusive. graph_compare now takes accept_timestamp_only (the user's own words).
